The plan's own informative m/n values (0.3129893 etc.) equal f*H_q(p) exactly (not ceil(f*H_q*1024)/1024), so the frozen intent is the continuous design rate and there is no inconsistency in the package; the '1 - m/n' wording is the finite-length formula that applies at V9B/V9C. Recommend the execution log restate this once for clarity.

ProcessTreeRSSWatcher.cap_exceeded uses strict '>' against cap_bytes (3221225472); an exact equality at 3 GiB would not trip, and the 10 s sampling window plus fail-open skip of transiently-exited children means the cap is a sampled bound, not a hard cgroup.
